critical_evidence.evidence:
CARFAX shows the following dated work:
- Oil changes 06/2018, 10/2019, 10/2022, 06/2023, 05/2024, 08/2025 and 09/2026.
- Brake fluid flushed 10/21/2022 at 21,130 mi.
- Rear diff fluid 08/13/2025.
Caveats: there is no reported entry between 10/2019 and 10/2022, and the brake fluid is now about 4 years old, so it is due again.

No transmission repair, warranty replacement or MT fluid service is reported. CARFAX NICB shows manufacture 03/28/2017, which is the early-2017 build window for the 6MT. A door-jamb build-date photo was not captured.

This is an RF, so the relevant drains are the targa/roof seal drains rather than soft-top drains, and water ingress still applies. Interior photos show tidy carpets with protective covers in place. No lifted-carpet, seat-rail or drain-area photos were examined here.

CARFAX (10/19/2026) reports no open recalls, and the dealer states the same as of 10/07/2026. Airbag-module recall 24V695000 covers 2016-2023 MX-5s. No completion line appears, although an unexplained Anderson Mazda dealer visit on 11/29/2024 may be it. Confirm with an NHTSA VIN lookup.

CARFAX records tires replaced 11/20/2023 at 28,611 mi and battery replaced 04/22/2026 at 36,860 mi (Auto Tech Centers). The tire brand is consistent with the photos. DOT and battery date codes not examined here.

documentation.rationale: Identity and terms are present: VIN, all-in price stated as including fees, and a clean title in a guaranteed CARFAX section. Maintenance evidence is also present: a 1-owner CARFAX with 12 dated service records covering brake fluid, diff fluid, tires, battery and recent oil. Missing are actual invoices, any transmission record, underside and cabin-water photos, and a build-date label.

condition.rationale: Photos show clean paint, straight panels, matching Continental tires with good tread on 2023 fitment, and stock appearance. There is minor creasing on the driver seat bolster. Underside (Illinois car), roof operation, gearbox behaviour and engine bay are unexamined, and no PPI exists.

price_value.rationale: $21,837 sits above the fair value band of $18,566-$20,648 (mid $19,497). A 2017 RF GT with 2,600 mi sold for $21,500 in Monterey, and a 12,992-mi 2017 RF GT peer is asking $21,450. There are no known-work deductions, but the asking price is above fair value.

mission_fit.rationale: Manual, low-risk Mazda drivetrain, easy to resell within 6-24 months, and within the ceiling though above the ideal band. It solves the bridge need with a clear enthusiast point of view. Early-2017 6MT history is the main open mechanical question.

logistics.rationale: Northern Illinois is far from Carmel. However, it is a cooperative dealer that invites inspection, independent PPI shops are available nearby, and there is a 5-day money-back policy. It is a straightforward fly-and-drive. CA smog and VIN verification are likely feasible but the emissions label is unconfirmed.

Several desirable traits come together:
- RF Grand Touring with the 6-speed manual.
- Machine Gray, one of the strongest-money colours.
- Single owner and apparently unmodified.
On the other side, it has the ND1 155 hp engine rather than the ND2.

ppi_focus: 6MT test when fully warm: listen for grinding or popping out on 2nd and 3rd, including quick 2-3 shifts; check the fluid condition.
Clutch: check engagement point, slip in 5th/6th under load, and pedal squeak.
Underside corrosion on an Illinois car: subframes, brake and fuel lines, rear diff mounts, pinch welds, exhaust hangers.
RF roof: cycle 5+ times, listen for creaks, rattles and hesitation; inspect targa seals and drains for clogging; water test if possible.
Cabin water: lift carpets, check underlay dampness, seat-rail bolt corrosion and floor connectors.
Oil seepage at the valve cover, timing cover and front crank seal; check rear diff pinion and output seals (the diff was serviced at Jiffy Lube, so confirm correct fluid and fill).
Water pump weep hole and coolant condition and age.
Paint meter around the nose, aluminum hood and fenders; check for chips, respray or PPF.
Scan all modules for stored codes; check the Mazda Connect screen for delamination or ghost touch; check firmware level.
Brake fluid moisture test, pad and rotor measurement, and alignment readings.
what_would_change_verdict: Up: a door-jamb label or Mazda warranty history showing a later-revision gearbox or no transmission complaints, plus a clean warm-gearbox PPI.
Up: a clean underside on a lift and flawless repeated roof cycling with dry cabin evidence.
Up: a negotiated price toward the $19.5k fair-value midpoint.
Down: grinding or synchro issues, underside rust, roof faults, a water-damaged cabin, or a dealer refusal of an independent PPI.
evidence.mission_note: This is a manual, one-owner ND RF with documented time-based upkeep, so it squarely fits the enthusiast bridge brief and should resell easily in 6-24 months. Its price sits above the ideal band and above the fair-value estimate, and the early-2017 6MT is the item to clear before money moves.
evidence.rationale:
The attached CARFAX corroborates the listing's main claims:
- One personal Illinois owner since April 2017 and a clean guaranteed title.
- No reported accidents, and odometer readings consistent with the advertised 38,972 miles.
- Every maintenance item the dealer cites, by date: brake fluid 10/2022, tires 11/2023, diff fluid 08/2025, battery 04/2026 and the 09/2026 PDI.

In the photos, the car is stock, the paint is clean, the Continental tires match and show good tread, and the only visible wear is light creasing on the driver bolster.

Open items:
- No reported service entry spans 10/2019 to 10/2022.
- The brake fluid is now about four years old.
- The car gained about 261 miles while in dealer stock.
- There is no transmission or MT fluid record on a car manufactured 03/28/2017, inside the early-6MT concern window.
- Underside corrosion on this salt-state car, roof operation and cabin dryness have not been examined.

The $21,837 asking price sits above the computed fair-value band of $18,566-$20,648.
evidence.next_action: Ask Buss Ford for the door-jamb build-date photo, the 09/04/2026 inspection sheet, the 11/29/2024 Anderson Mazda RO and lift photos of the underside, and book an independent PPI near McHenry before any deposit.
